note: the layout the decider family is trained on. its ggufs carry the base model's chat template, which the model never saw, so the affixes are declared here rather than derived. past 26 options decider switches to two-letter labels, so a longer list is refused here rather than labelled with letters it was not trained on. decider's loss covers only the option-letter rows, so the rest of the vocabulary keeps a thin tail: measured on the verification question, 0.87-0.93 of the mass sits on the listed letters with the answer on top, the largest other token holds 0.006 and unlisted letters hold under 0.01. the formatter floor is set below that range and far above a wrong opening.
